proposition_text: The occupier of a holding must ensure that in any twelve-month period, the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure spread on any given hectare of land on the holding does not exceed 250kg.
label: Nitrogen limit in organic manure: 250kg per hectare per year
action: must ensure that the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure spread does not exceed
conditions: exception: occupier may exceed limit if three conditions relating to certified green compost or certified green/food compost are met
exception: regulation does not apply where at least 80% of holding is grass, nitrogen limits from organic manure and manufactured fertiliser are met, and no organic manure is brought onto the holding
temporal: in any twelve-month period
affected_subjects: 250kg per hectare in any twelve-month period
notes: Core nitrogen limit obligation with clear subject, rule, object, and temporal scope; exceptions detailed in subsequent paragraphs.
review_notes: Core nitrogen limit obligation with clear subject, rule, object, and temporal scope; exceptions detailed in subsequent paragraphs.

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: The occupier of a holding must ensure that in any twelve-month period, the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure spread on any given hectare of land on the holding does not exceed 250kg.

proposition_text: The occupier may exceed the 250kg nitrogen limit if organic manure is in the form of certified green compost or certified green/food compost, the nitrogen amount in such compost does not exceed specified limits, and no other form of organic manure is spread during the applicable period.
label: Exception: certified compost may exceed 250kg limit under three conditions
conditions: Condition 1: organic manure is in the form of certified green compost or certified green/food compost
Condition 2: nitrogen in compost does not exceed 500kg in two years (or 1,000kg in four years for orchard mulch)
Condition 3: no other form of organic manure is spread during the applicable period
notes: Exception to core limit with three distinct conditions clearly enumerated; all conditions must be met.
review_notes: Exception to core limit with three distinct conditions clearly enumerated; all conditions must be met.

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: But the occupier may exceed that limit if the following three conditions are met. 3 Condition 1 is that organic manure is in the form of certified green compost or certified green/food compost. 4 Condition 2 is that the total amount of nitrogen in the form of green compost or green/food compost which is spread on any given hectare of land on the holding does not exceed— a 500kg in any two-year period, whether the compost is spread as mulch or incorporated into the soil, or b in the case of orchard land, 1,000kg in any four-year period if it is spread as mulch. 5 Condition 3 is that no other form of organic manure is spread over the land in question during the applicable period provided for under paragraph (4)(a) or (b).

proposition_text: For certified green compost or green/food compost, the total amount of nitrogen spread on any given hectare must not exceed 500kg in any two-year period, whether spread as mulch or incorporated into the soil.
label: Compost nitrogen limit: 500kg per hectare in two years
legal_subject: total amount of nitrogen in the form of green compost or green/food compost
conditions: organic manure is in the form of certified green compost or certified green/food compost
compost is spread as mulch or incorporated into the soil
exception: for orchard land, 1,000kg in four years if spread as mulch
temporal: in any two-year period
affected_subjects: 500kg per hectare in any two-year period
notes: Specific quantitative limit for compost nitrogen under Condition 2; distinct from orchard exception.
review_notes: Specific quantitative limit for compost nitrogen under Condition 2; distinct from orchard exception.

proposition_text: For orchard land, the total amount of nitrogen in certified green compost or green/food compost spread as mulch must not exceed 1,000kg per hectare in any four-year period.
label: Orchard compost nitrogen limit: 1,000kg per hectare in four years

proposition_text: Regulation 8 does not apply if at least 80% of the holding's agricultural area is sown with grass, nitrogen from organic manure does not exceed 100kg per hectare, nitrogen from manufactured fertiliser does not exceed 90kg per hectare, the occupier does not bring organic manure onto the holding, and the occupier makes a record demonstrating these requirements are met.
label: Grassland exemption from nitrogen limits
conditions: at least 80% of holding's agricultural area is sown with grass throughout the year
nitrogen in organic manure applied does not exceed 100kg × area in hectares
nitrogen from manufactured fertiliser does not exceed 90kg × area in hectares
occupier does not bring organic manure onto the holding
occupier makes a record demonstrating requirements are met
temporal: throughout the year concerned
affected_subjects: requirements in paragraph (7) are met and occupier makes a record
notes: Complete exemption with five distinct conditions; all must be met and recorded.
review_notes: Complete exemption with five distinct conditions; all must be met and recorded.

extraction_debug_meta.evidence_quote: This regulation does not apply in a case where— a the requirements in paragraph (7) are met, and b the occupier makes a record demonstrating that they are met. 7 The requirements in this paragraph are that throughout the year concerned— a at least 80% of the holding's agricultural area is sown with grass, b the total amount of nitrogen in organic manure applied to the holding, whether directly by an animal or spreading, does not exceed 100kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares, c the total amount of nitrogen from manufactured nitrogen fertiliser applied to the holding does not exceed 90kg multiplied by the area of the holding in hectares, and d the occupier does not bring organic manure on to the holding.

proposition_text: For the purposes of the grassland exemption, the area of the holding does not include any land on which the occupier does not spread fertiliser or work the soil.

proposition_text: The 250kg nitrogen limit does not apply to land covered by a greenhouse for the whole of the period concerned.
label: Greenhouse land excluded from nitrogen limit
conditions: land is covered by a greenhouse for the whole of the period concerned
temporal: for the whole of the period concerned
affected_subjects: land covered by a greenhouse for the whole of the period concerned
notes: Exception excluding greenhouse-covered land from core nitrogen limit; temporal condition is integral.
